caption_note: Material treatment MISSING: painted in temple_ruin -- the SAME family as T01, deliberately, to test whether reuse costs identity.

lamps.why: the bracket lantern, amber and low. Twilight Town's whole identity is a sun that never finishes setting, and a lantern is what you light against it rather than instead of it.
the sun itself, down the alley the awning gate leads to -- warm from the low side, which is the opposite of every other pack's cold doorway
sky bounce, cool, so the warm light has something to be warm AGAINST

place.why: on the opening; the canopy is ROLLED, because a deployed one is headroom and headroom is Production's
clear of the approach; the cable bracket reaches into the room
and the opposite pier faces the same way, because a catenary runs BETWEEN two brackets and two brackets pointing apart carry nothing
the boarded window faces the alley; the wall stands proud so the four thicknesses read
bracket height on the opposite wall, with the broken face toward the street
batch043's wall-switch contract: beside the door, at hand height -- the same place as T01's, T02's, T03's and T04's
two displaced lengths, not one continuous run: a continuous rail reads as walkable infrastructure and floor is Production's
